To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a single direct placement trial to a goal box is sufficient to establish the "reinforcing value" of the stimulus characteristics, and (2) that the "reinforcement value" of the training goal box can be transferred to other goal boxes of different brightnesses by means of classical conditioning procedures.

The use of the direct feeding method of establishing a reward value for the goal box stimulus characteristics is sufficient to produce a learning effect in a subsequent T-maze test, and that this learning effect is not dependent upon the presence of an incentive motivational factor.
